entities.title: Login service public keys
entities.summary: The JWKS the app checks sign-in tokens against. Public, the same line every icelander.net app carries.
entities.details: Without it, or without the ACCOUNTS binding, nobody can sign in (fail closed).

entities.title: Stand-in sign-in for tests
entities.summary: DEV_SIGN_IN="true" turns on /calendar/auth/dev, only on a localhost address.
entities.details: Must be the string "true"; wrangler's --var passes a boolean, which the library ignores. Needs --local-upstream localhost:<port>.
